name: Lateral hops and skaters
pattern: Side-to-side jumping: push off one or both feet, travel sideways, and land balanced over a bent knee.
setup: Stand on your right leg, knee and hip slightly bent, chest leaning a little forward.
Left foot off the floor behind you.
Clear space of about two body widths to each side.

steps.text: Sink into your right hip and knee.
Push sideways off your right foot, swinging your arms across.
Land on your left foot, knee bent and over your toes, right foot sweeping behind.
Load the left leg and bound back to the right.

cues.cue: Land with the knee over your toes, not inside them.
cues.why: Knee valgus on landing predicts ACL injury.

cues.cue: Land soft and stick it before the next push.
cues.why: A bent-knee, controlled landing lowers impact force.

cues.cue: Sit into the hip and push out with the glute.
cues.why: Sideways jumps rely on frontal-plane hip and ankle control, not just knee bend.
Leaning past the foot shifts load to the inside of the knee.

breathing: Steady breaths; breathe out on each push.

tempo.note: For balance and power: stick each landing 1-2 s. For conditioning: continuous rhythm.

mistakes.name: Knee caves in
mistakes.looks: The landing knee falls inside the foot.
mistakes.fix: Shorter hops; push the knee out over the little toes.

mistakes.name: Stiff landing
mistakes.looks: The landing leg is nearly straight and the hop is loud.
mistakes.fix: Land on the ball of the foot and sink into the hip.
mistakes.why: More impact goes to the knee and ankle.

mistakes.name: Torso tips sideways
mistakes.looks: The upper body leans far over the landing leg or away from it.
mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders level, chest over the knee.
mistakes.why: Trunk lean moves load to the knee and suggests weak hip control.

safety: Start with small hops and two-foot versions.
Ankle sprain history: practise on a flat, non-slip floor and build up.
Stop when landings get wobbly or loud.

variants.change: Two feet together, hop side to side over a line, hurdle or low step.
Hops on one leg: side to side, front to back, or a square pattern.
Hops forward and back or with a foot cross; same landing rules.
Holding a ball at the chest; less arm swing.
Continuous skaters in intervals: about 11.0 MET (02214).

subtypes.name: Side-to-side hops
subtypes.match: side to side|lateral jump|hurdle|step ?box|side jump|calf side
subtypes.change: Feet together, quick hops side to side.

subtypes.name: Single-leg hops
subtypes.change: Stay on one leg; small hops in the set direction, free knee bent.

easier: two-foot side hops over a line

motion.basis: Landing rules from hewett2005, ford2003 and padua2009 (bilateral landing studies applied to single-leg landings); frontal-plane demands from lateral-ssc2010. Keyframe angles are estimates. MET 7.5 is Compendium 02020; continuous intervals 11.0 (02214).
